_comment: Fallback console front door (2026-11-18): Pages stopped executing _worker.js on this account, so the same proxy runs as a standalone Worker until Pages Functions recover. D1/KV bindings mirror the Pages project (same qwenpaw-state DB, same STATUS KV) so sleep/wake visit signals keep flowing. No secret bindings: the Pages secrets (DESKTOP_*_TOKEN, VAULT_*, RESET_TOKEN, INSTABOX_API_KEY) are not readable via the API and are never invented — /computer session mint, /vault reveal, /reset execution and Rest are degraded in the fallback. Plain-text vars MUST be plain_text bindings (a top-level vars object is silently dropped). After upload, enable the workers.dev route with POST /workers/scripts/qwenpaw-console/subdomain {"enabled": true} (a fresh script has it disabled).
name: qwenpaw-console
